scope: hair.html PBR crop01/g050, viewport 1400x1100, capture clock, four sequential pages; no all-scene performance claim

runs.hud:
Renderer            : WebGPU
Groom               : crop01 g050 — Men's short back-and-sides with length on top, faded through the cut field.
Figure              : figure_g050.glb

geometry            : 0 verts, 0 triangles
material            : MASK, cutoff 0.5, double sided
skinned to          : head
atlas               : 1024², 8 strips, cap strip 0

!! THIS IS NOT THE HAIR SHADER. Punch-list 3.5 owns the
anisotropic strand model and runs after this. What is drawn here is a plain
Principled material with the generated albedo + normal sheets, so that the
GEOMETRY can be judged without a shader in front of it.

What to look for, in the order it goes wrong:
  3/4    does a STRAIGHT line cross the brow, the lid or the cheekbone? That is a
         card's own quad edge.
  side   is the silhouette hair, or a helmet with ribbon edges? And does the mass
         separate into LOCKS, or is every card going its own way? A fan reads as a mop.
  top    does the scalp show between the cards? That is what the cap is for.
  front  is the parting readable, and is hair across the EYES? A groom may cross the
         temple and must not cross an eye — this page is a face.
  front  and where the SIDE CURTAIN crosses the cheek, can you still read the eyebrow
         arc, the lid crease, the nostril wing or the jawline THROUGH it? A curtain one
         to two cards deep over skin is a window; hair_opacity.mjs C4 is that number.
  front  and zoom the cheek where a card lies over skin: do the strand stripes read as
         STRIPES, or as an axis-aligned dot pattern? That is the coverage decision, not
         the atlas — hair_tips.mjs measures it and REQ-073 owns the fix.
  back   do the ends land on a CUT LINE, or scatter over a hand's width? Scattered ends
         are what three separate observers called "messy", "stringy" and "unwashed".

The numbers are gated elsewhere and none of them can answer any of the above:
  node tools/figure-pipeline/verify_glb.mjs assets/hair/bob01/g050.glb

?motion=1  DFTL on 384 chains × 17 rings = 6528 particles, 0.008333 s substep
head       shake, timestep fixed, defect none
skull      sphere r=78.1 mm at the least-squares scalp centre (fit r=95.4 mm), nearest rest particle 78.1 mm
A/B        drop ?motion=1 for the rigid control — same page, same framing.
